Name: Animated Cowboy Life Expanded Fish
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[b][u][size=6]Animated Cowboy Life Expanded Fish

[/size][/u][/b][size=3]Adds animations to 38 items from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7176]The Cowboy Life Expanded[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53638721?tab=user+files]Hamio[/url].

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/MTDf8dkw/anaconda.gif[/img] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿[b][u][size=6][img]https://i.postimg.cc/rmcRb7Pg/blue-crab.gif[/img][/size][/u][/b][/center][u][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7176]The Cowboy Life Expanded[/url] ﻿(and of course the mods required to run that)

Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[size=5][u][b]Config[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i]config.json[/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i][size=3]content.json[/size][/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.
Run the game once to generate the config.json.
[/size][/size][/size][/size][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/jSp76D6p/red-starfish.gif[/img] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/yN0SL7vk/sea-turtle.gif[/img][/center][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Link to my other animated fish mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5735]Animated Fish[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5845]Animated More New Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6089]Animated Fish SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7353]Animated Ridgeside Village Fish[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10913]Animated East Scarp Fish[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6974]Animated Lunna - Astay Fish[/url].
[/size][/size][/size]Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53638721?tab=user+files]Hamio [/url]for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7176]The Cowboy Life Expanded [/url]mod.[/size][/size]
